    Teaching

    Intermediate (modern) physics lab

    Undergraduate course, Florida International University, 2025

    All course materials are currently on the FIU Canvas site. We complete 8 modern physics lab experiments and learn how to code in python, conduct error & uncertainty analysis, compose lab reports, and give APS-style presentations. Many course materials are accessible here.

    22nd STFC Nuclear Physics Summer School

    Summer school, Durham University, 2024

    This Nuclear Physics Summer School took place at the University of Duham, UK and is primarily focused on information for first and second year graduate students. My talks were focused on experimental hadronic physics overviews and can be accessed from the program.

    Hampton University Graduate School on Nuclear Physics

    Summer school, Jefferson Lab, 2023

    The HUGS Program at Jefferson Lab is an educational summer program designed for experimental and theoretical nuclear and particle physics graduate students who have finished their coursework and have at least one year of research experience in these fields. The program is simultaneously intensive, friendly, and casual. My talks were focused on QCD dynamics in electron-nucleus collisions and can be accessed from the program here.
